claim_boundary: The earlier connectivity smoke establishes authenticated provider access only; it is not a repository-task result.

One initial trial under one Nebius/NVIDIA configuration is pilot evidence, not statistically meaningful, multi-model, or production-scale evidence.
Every observed outcome, including HOLD, VERIFIED_FAIL, failed repair, or VERIFIED_PASS, must be preserved without normalization or replacement.
The AP-001 Section 9 gap closes only if this run yields public-test pass, qualified-verifier rejection, bounded repair, VERIFIED_PASS, and successful source-exact no-model replay.
